text:
emma_cs: FYI customer (FinNova) just escalated their CAIQ. They want: KMS/HSM rotation evidence + current HSM attestation, audit log extract for the last 90 days, and repro steps for a 401 spike they observed last week. Also noticed a billing spike around the same window. Who can own collection and a short deliverable ETA? cc @lisa_security @raj_engineering

lisa_security: I'm taking ownership of the attestations and key rotation timeline. Will check HSM vendor certs and attestation PDF. Do we have an existing 90-day log export for that org? :eyes:

raj_engineering: I can investigate the 401s and the billing blip. Need the customer's org id + any sample request_ids they sent in the support email to pin repro. Also what timezone/window do they want for the audit extract?

deploy-bot: IncidentBot created INC-2024-152 for "FinNova CAIQ - KMS/audit/logs" (priority: P2)

emma_cs: org id: finnova-001. Customer provided three sample request_ids in their email: rq_20250109_9a1b, rq_20250110_f7c2, rq_20250111_3d4e. They want "last 90 days" relative to today (so rolling). Billing spike observed 2025-01-09 to 2025-01-12.

raj_engineering: Thanks. Quick repro steps I'll run locally and then produce sanitized exports:

```
# export 401 events
redwoodctl logs export --org finnova-001 --from 2024-10-13 --to 2025-01-11 --filter 'status:401' --out finnova-401.ndjson
# KMS/HSM audit events (key rotation, wrap/unwrap, key usage)
redwoodctl audit export --org finnova-001 --event KMS_KEY_* --from 2024-10-13 --to 2025-01-11 --out finnova-kms.ndjson
# filter by provided request ids
jq 'select(.request_id=="rq_20250109_9a1b" or .request_id=="rq_20250110_f7c2" or .request_id=="rq_20250111_3d4e")' finnova-401.ndjson
```

raj_engineering: After export I'll run the sanitization script to redact PII before handing to CS: `scripts/redact_log_fields.sh finnova-401.ndjson > finnova-401-redacted.ndjson`

lisa_security: For the HSM attestation: vendor provides a signed PDF plus a rotation log we keep in internal S3 at s3://redwood-audit/hsm-attestations/. I'll pull the FinNova file and verify the cert chain. Will include key IDs (kid) and rotation timestamps. Note: attestation for that HSM expires 2025-03-01.

emma_cs: Great. For the CAIQ deliverable I need: 1) a short spreadsheet mapping controls->evidence (one row per control), 2) the redacted audit log sample (max 5k lines), 3) HSM attestation PDF + rotation timeline. ETA target?

lisa_security: ETA EOD tomorrow for attestation + rotation timeline. I'll link the S3 object once pulled. :thumbsup:

raj_engineering: I should have sanitized log extracts and a short repro note in ~6-8 hours. Preliminary look shows a cluster of 401s from retry storms around 2025-01-10 tied to token refresh failures; might explain billing spike due to retries. I'll add metrics snapshot (qps, error rate) to the export.

emma_cs: Perfect. I'll tell the customer T+24h for artifacts and share a secure upload link for evidence. Also opening an internal billing ticket to investigate cost impact: BILL-947 created.

raj_engineering: Sample redacted 401 log snippet (I'll include more in the export):

```
{"ts":"2025-01-10T14:03:21Z","request_id":"rq_20250110_f7c2","client_ip":"<redacted>","user_id":"<redacted>","endpoint":"/v1/generate","status":401,"err":"token_expired"}
```

lisa_security: Note for CAIQ evidence: for control ECC-3 we can point to the HSM attestation PDF and rotation table. For control LOG-7 we should provide the redacted audit log + a one-paragraph explanation of retention policy (90 days hot, 2 years cold archive).

emma_cs: I'll assemble the CAIQ mapping and draft the email. Once you both drop artifacts here I'll review and upload to the secure customer share. Thanks team.

raj_engineering: One more quick mitigation: recommend enabling soft rate-limiting per org + exponential backoff guidance for their SDKs while we patch the token refresh edge case. I'll attach suggested config snippet in the export.

emma_cs: Noted. I'll include that in the customer response. Closing loop after artifacts posted.
